recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-46668 unless a later work group decision changes the vital signs hierarchy or creates separate single-value and multi-value core vital signs profiles.
issue_request: FHIR-46668 was an Applied/Persuasive with Modification OO change request asking what to do when jurisdictional vital signs profiles such as head circumference or waist circumference do not have components but inherit from the base vital signs profile. Its resolution says the issue was fixed with the Vital Signs Base Profile by removing MustSupport on .component.
initial_application: No git commit explicitly mentions FHIR-46668. The relevant source state was applied through the same vital signs profile work: FHIR-46418 reworked the profile family and renamed the shared profile to Vital Signs Base Profile, and FHIR-47136 removed MustSupport from Observation.component in the base/non-blood-pressure vital signs profiles while retaining blood-pressure-specific component requirements.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini keeps Observation active, and implementationguide-Observation-vitalsigns.xml marks the vital signs implementation guide as core and includes StructureDefinition/vitalsigns. OO WGM minutes for 2025-09 record FHIR-46668 as pre-applied, specifically noting that component is no longer MustSupport in the base and remains MustSupport for blood pressure. FHIR-30934 is related background for defining vital signs MustSupport semantics, but it does not require a different FHIR-46668 edit.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source change was made because the current Vital Signs Base Profile already permits component-less vital signs via value[x], dataAbsentReason, or hasMember and does not mark Observation.component MustSupport; the blood pressure profile still carries component cardinality and MustSupport where required.
